full_prompt_en: A square fantasy concept painting portrays a dark-haired adventurer from the waist upward against a sunlit, dust-filled old city. Warm ocher buildings recede across the left background, with a tall tower and arched gateway rising above lower roofs. Their shapes dissolve into a pale beige sky and drifting dust, so the city remains recognizable without competing with the figure. On the right, a dark vertical wall closes the space and pushes the subject forward. The man stands near the center-right, shoulders turned away while his face looks back toward the viewer. Tousled black hair frames his narrowed eyes and firm mouth; light catches his forehead, nose, and cheek, while deeper brown shadow crosses the jaw. A vivid red cloak wraps around his shoulder and falls behind him at the right edge. Beneath it, dark leather clothing is crossed by straps, metal trim, and worn gold embroidery. The near sleeve combines burgundy cloth, scuffed leather, and small decorative lines, all built from textured, layered paint. His lower arm is cropped by the frame, leaving the shoulder and searching gaze as the visual emphasis. Strong warm light enters from the upper left, striking the tower, airborne dust, face, and gold edges of the clothing. The wall and underside of the red cloak remain in deep umber shadow, with cool dark marks giving the foreground extra weight. Broad brush scumbles soften the distant city, while finer strokes sharpen eyes, hair, and fabric edges. The overall composition is heroic yet intimate, balancing a close, dark silhouette against a luminous ocher city and the concentrated red sweep of cloth.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形奇幻概念画描绘一位黑发冒险者的腰部以上形象，背景是一座沐浴阳光、弥漫尘雾的古城。暖赭色建筑沿左侧远退，高塔和拱形城门高出较低屋顶。它们融入浅米色天空与浮动尘埃，因此城市仍可辨认，却不与人物争夺注意。右侧一道深色竖墙收住空间，将主体推向前景。男子站在中右部，肩膀转开，脸却回望观者。凌乱黑发围住微眯双眼和坚定的嘴，光落在额头、鼻梁和面颊，下颌横着更深棕影。鲜红斗篷裹住肩头，并从右缘向后垂落。其下深色皮衣交错着带子、金属饰边和磨损金色刺绣。近处袖子混合勃艮第红布、擦旧皮革与细小装饰线，均由有肌理的层叠颜料构成。下臂被画框裁去，肩部与探寻的目光成为视觉重点。强烈暖光从左上方进入，照亮高塔、悬浮尘埃、面孔和衣服金边。墙体与红斗篷下侧仍在深棕影中，冷暗笔痕给前景增重。宽阔干擦笔触柔化远城，更细的笔迹则加强眼睛、头发与衣料边缘。整体构图英勇而亲密，以近处深色剪影平衡明亮赭色城市与集中的红色布料扫势。
style_prompt_en: A cinematic fantasy painting builds a close dark focal mass against a luminous, dusty middle distance. Warm ocher, sand, amber, and umber cover most of the setting, while a concentrated sweep of deep crimson supplies strong color emphasis. Forms are modeled with layered oil-like strokes: broad scumbled marks soften distant planes, and fine, sharper touches pick out focal edges, worn material, and metallic glints. Atmospheric dust compresses contrast with distance, but near dark shapes retain weight and tactile relief. Warm directional light enters from one upper side, catching raised surfaces and leaving deep brown recesses and cooler dark underside tones. Tall structural silhouettes and diagonal folds guide the eye toward the central illuminated zone. The overall effect is dramatic, weathered, and richly physical, with clear depth carried by value and texture rather than graphic flatness.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感奇幻绘画将近处深暗焦点量块置于明亮多尘的中远景之前。暖赭、沙色、琥珀与深棕覆盖大部分环境，集中扫过的深绯红提供强色彩重点。形体由层叠的油画式笔触塑造：宽阔干擦痕迹柔化远处平面，较细而清晰的点笔挑出焦点边缘、磨损材料与金属闪光。空气中的尘埃压低远处反差，近处深色形状仍保持重量和可触浮凸。定向暖光从一侧上方进入，照亮凸起表面，在凹处留下深棕和偏冷的下侧暗调。高竖结构剪影与斜向褶线引导目光抵达中央亮区。整体戏剧性强、饱经风化且富物质感，明确纵深由明度和肌理承担，而非图形化平涂。
theme_en: A dark-haired adventurer in a red cloak before a sunlit old city
theme_zh: 黑发冒险者披红斗篷，身后是日照中的古城
name: 史诗波斯奇幻概念画
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
